notes: References everywhere, via training. A Train face LoRA button in the character editor turns the reference photos into a likeness LoRA on fal (a few minutes, roughly $2) and adds it to the character automatically, trigger word included — so the face from your references holds in every photo, including the 18+ shots where reference images can't ride along. Reference slots also grow from 3 to 10; more references train a better likeness.
